payload.arguments: {"questions":[{"header":"Routing","id":"long","question":"When sending a large fixture payload through a helper process while the receiver is temporarily unavailable and the terminal is narrow, which transport should preserve delivery ordering, retries, and a clear progress indication for the person waiting at the laptop?","options":[{"label":"HTTP helper (Recommended)","description":"Send a complete request through a helper process, retain the payload until the receiver confirms delivery, and show progress while retrying temporary failures without duplicating accepted messages."},{"label":"WebSocket stream","description":"Stream smaller chunks over a persistent connection, reconnect when needed, preserve chunk ordering across retries, and display partial progress even when the receiver takes a long time to recover."}]}]}
